articles.summary: Cable One, Inc. (NYSE: CABO) will host a conference call with the financial community to discuss results for the third quarter 2026 on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 5 p.m. Eastern Time (ET). Cable One will issue a press release reporting its results after market close on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The conference call will be available via a live audio webcast on the Cable One Investor Relations website at ir.cableone.net or by dialing 1-833-461-5787 (International: 1-585-542-9983) and using the meeting ID 815383572. Participants should register for the webcast or dial in for the conference call shortly before 5 p.m. ET. A replay of the call will be available from November 5, 2026 until December 3, 2026 at ir.cableone.net. To automatically receive Cable One financial news by email, please visit the Cable One Investor Relations website and subscribe to Email Alerts. About Cable One Cable One, Inc. articles.summary: Cable One, Inc. (NYSE: CABO) (Cable One or the Company) today announced it is in advanced discussions with GTCR LLC (GTCR), certain of its existing lenders and a consortium of leading private lending institutions regarding financing transactions to address certain of the Companys forthcoming capital needs. Cable One is working towards enhancing its capital structure to position the company to drive growth in shareholder value. We are pleased at the momentum and interest from existing stakeholders and new investors, who are collaborating with us to formulate a solution that supports the future of Cable One. The contemplated financings are intended to strengthen Cable Ones overall financial position, said Jim Holanda, Chief Executive Officer of Cable One. articles.summary: Company has agreed in principle on material terms with GTCR and other lenders regarding a financing solution Cable One, Inc. (NYSE: CABO) (“Cable One” or the “Company”) today announced that, on October 9, 2026, the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York entered a temporary restraining order (the “TRO”) that temporarily prohibits Cable One from acquiring the 55% of Mega Broadband Investments Holdings LLC (“MBI”) that it does not currently own. The action was commenced by CoBank, ACB, a lender under the Company's existing credit agreement. The complaint alleges that the Company's payment of the MBI purchase price would constitute a constructive fraudulent transfer. CoBank is seeking, among other things, an injunction prohibiting the Company from closing the MBI acquisition. The TRO was entered prior to any hearing or court appearance by Cable One.
